system.name: PowerInfer
system.one_liner: a high-speed LLM inference engine on a PC with a single consumer-grade GPU exploiting activation locality

components.name: LLM
components.role: input model whose activation patterns are profiled

components.name: Profiler & Solver
components.role: offline profiler collecting activation data and solving hot/cold neuron placement

components.name: Hot
components.role: frequently activated neurons, preloaded on GPU

components.name: Cold
components.role: rarely activated neurons, kept on CPU

components.name: CPU Executor
components.role: executes computation for cold-activated neurons on CPU

components.name: GPU Executor
components.role: executes computation for hot-activated neurons on GPU with predicated activation

components.name: Predicated Activation
components.role: runtime prediction of whether a neuron will be active

components.name: PCIe
components.role: interconnect between CPU and GPU components

content.key_idea: An offline profiler classifies neurons as hot or cold based on activation frequency; online, hot neurons are preloaded on the GPU and cold neurons stay on the CPU, with a predicated-activation executor on each side computing only the neurons likely to be active.
content.reading_order: left to right: Offline box (LLM, Profiler & Solver with hot/cold neuron grids) feeds into the Online box on the right, split top (CPU/GPU Executors) and bottom (CPU/GPU Mem), connected via PCIe, with a legend of icons at the top.

summary: PowerInfer speeds up LLM inference on a single consumer GPU by exploiting the locality of neuron activations. Figure 7 shows its architecture and workflow split into an Offline and an Online phase, with an inline icon legend (hot/cold neuron, predicated activation, CPU core, GPU SM, calculation vs. loading arrows) at the top. Offline, a Profiler & Solver analyzes the LLM's activation data and partitions neurons into hot (frequently activated, green) and cold (rarely activated, gray) sets. Online, these placements determine that hot-neuron weights are preloaded into GPU Mem and cold-neuron weights stay in CPU Mem; a GPU Executor and CPU Executor each use predicated activation to compute only the neurons predicted active, communicating over PCIe. Circled numbers trace the flow from profiling through partitioning to the online CPU/GPU execution and data loading.
summary_zh: 图7展示PowerInfer的离线-在线架构：离线阶段的Profiler & Solver依据激活频率将神经元分为热（绿色，常激活）与冷（灰色，少激活）；在线阶段热神经元权重预载入GPU显存、冷神经元留在CPU内存，CPU与GPU执行器通过PCIe协同、按预测激活仅计算所需神经元，图顶部附带图标图例。
